description: Get the live counterparty risk score (ESG-denominated) for a wallet address or the protocol default. Returns Environmental, Social, and Governance risk scores (0–100 each), composite weighted average, and the compliance-adjusted settlement fee percentage this score produces. Updated hourly from 6 institutional data sources: WorldBank, IMF, OECD, UN SDG API, ClimateMonitor, and SEC EDGAR. Required by EU SFDR Principal Adverse Impact reporting and CSRD financed emissions disclosure for institutional clients.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...) to score. Omit for protocol default.

name: esg.score

feePct.description: ESG fee percentage applied at settlement
